title: The open–closed sequence for module sheaves over a sheaf of rings
statement:
Let $X$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ a
quasi-compact open immersion with closed complement $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$,
and $B$ a sheaf of rings on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$, with coefficient rings $j^*B$
on $U$ and $i^*B$ on $Z$. Then:

1. $j^*$ and $j_!$ are exact, $j_!\dashv j^*$, and the unit
$N\to j^*j_!N$ is an isomorphism;
2. $i_*$ is exact, the counit $i^*i_*G\to G$ is an isomorphism (so $i_*$ is
fully faithful), and $j^*i_*=0$;
3. for every $B$-module sheaf $M$ the sequence
$0\to j_!j^*M\to M\to i_*i^*M\to0$, formed by the counit of $j_!\dashv j^*$
and the unit of $i^*\dashv i_*$, is exact;
4. for a morphism $g:X'\to X$ with $X'$ qcqs and base changes
$j':U'\to X'$, $i':Z'\to X'$, $g_U:U'\to U$, $g_Z:Z'\to Z$, there are
canonical isomorphisms $g^*j_!\simeq j'_!g_U^*$, $g^*i_*\simeq i'_*g_Z^*$, and
$g^*$ carries the sequence of (3) for $M$ to the sequence of (3) for $g^*M$.

proof.text: Import the closed localization lemma to obtain finite-colimit preservation for i_*, its invertible counit, disjoint-support vanishing and the exact counit-unit sequence.

The existing module-object inverse image and open extension preserve finite limits, and inverse image preserves finite colimits. Open extension preserves finite colimits because its actual module adjunction makes it a left adjoint; closed direct image preserves finite limits because its module adjunction makes it a right adjoint. Forget the open module unit: by the definition of mapModLeftAdjunction its carrier is the abelian open unit. Full faithfulness of abelian extension by zero makes that unit invertible; Mod.forget reflects isomorphisms.

Import canonical base-change mates. The ranges of the pulled-back immersions are inverse images of the original ranges, so remain complementary. Apply closed localization on X′ to g^*M to obtain the base-changed short exact sequence.

For the open sequence-arrow equation, cancel alpha inverse, transpose through the pulled-back open adjunction, substitute its defining transpose, and use naturality of delta inverse and the right triangle identity for the original open adjunction. For the closed equation, transpose through the pulled-back closed adjunction, substitute the defining transpose of beta, and use naturality of gamma and the left triangle identity. Injectivity of the hom equivalences proves the actual arrow equations.

proof_origin.place: Original open/closed route; complete Lean proof from the proved localization and canonical mate lemmas, categorical exactness instances, the open unit, and both triangle-identity sequence-arrow equations. No residual holes.

split_report.summary: Retained and audited the inherited repair against the current blueprint and Stacks. Proved the complete arbitrary-ring statement using existing ringed localization for the constant integer sheaf, explicit module actions and linear adjunct equations, actual unit/counit isomorphisms, and arbitrary-base-change mate equations. Separated coefficient construction, slice restriction and the triangle-identity calculation into individually checkable steps; no new nodes. Re-ran Mathlib searches with two semantic phrasings and recorded actual results. Checked every cited statement and all four clauses, including the two sequence-map equations. No target statement or unit/chapter metadata changed.
split_report.blueprint: Steps 1--3 realize the coefficient paragraph; Steps 4--7 realize parts (1)--(3) via existing general localization statements. Steps 8--11 realize part (4), including arbitrary inverse-image composition, the closed mate, and both actual sequence-map equations. This follows the open/closed route of the unit without its obsolete SGA references.

tool_uses.why: Existing arbitrary-commutative-ringed pro-etale localization theorem, applied only to the constant integer sheaf to obtain abelian facts along the same open/closed route; avoids misuse of finite-coefficient lemmas.
Generic exact faithful forgetful functor for arbitrary coefficient sheaves; used to check module exactness on abelian sheaves.
Generic exactness of site inverse image supplies exactness of j^*, i^* and g^* with inverse-image coefficients.
Generic adjunction-compatible composition of inverse images supplies both cartesian-square identifications and the precise mate equations for arbitrary base change.
Only its geometric slice-site equivalence and monicity clauses (1),(4) are used to construct extension by zero for arbitrary B.
Geometric permanence under arbitrary base change checks that the open/closed localization theorem applies on X′.
Geometric permanence under arbitrary base change checks that the closed map on X′ is a closed immersion.
Geometric permanence of quasi-compactness checks the required hypothesis on the complementary open j′.

This holds for arbitrary g, not only weakly etale g. Edge cases checked: U empty (including a nilpotent Z), U=X, X' empty, B=0, g=id, g landing in U or in Z, and noncommutative B. No duplicates: lem-sf-proetale-open-closed-sequence, lem-weil-pbc-open-closed-short-exact, the ringed localization lemma, the condensed recollement and det-sf-open-closed-pullback-limits all state different things.
